about_the_game:
An abandoned boarding school… Footsteps echoing through silent hallways… And a vengeful spirit from the past…

Years ago, a tragic event at a boarding school took a dear friend from you. But this story didn’t end with death. Now, you’ve been called back to that dark past through a letter. In the ruins of this abandoned school, the restless spirit of your friend awaits.

Explore the abandoned rooms, find hidden keys, and try to escape the grip of a deadly danger. But be careful… They’re watching your every move, and this time, scaring you won’t be their only game.

name: The Unrested

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10+
  • Processor: Intel i5 or AMD equivalent (AMD FX 8500+ Series)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 2 GB Video RAM
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10+
  • Processor: Intel i5 or AMD equivalent (AMD FX 8500+ Series)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 4 GB Video RAM
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 3 GB available space

short_description: The Unrested is a story-driven first-person horror game. A spirit from your past traps you in an abandoned boarding school. A shadow watching your every step will test you with puzzles while forcing you to confront your fears.
supported_languages:
English*, French, Italian, German, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Spanish - Latin America, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian, Turkish
*languages with full audio support
